posts.post_subject: After 3 years, I'm back! Anyone doing cheap pulsed holos?
posts.content_md:
Dear Holographers,

It was almost exactly 3 years ago that I made my first pulsed green hologram with a souped up SSY1 laser. I have decided to try to set up my "lab" and continue my experiments.

Anyone play with making pulsed holograms with inexpensive equiptment? I'd love to find if any of the roughly 200 SSY1 units I sold were made into a pulsed holography system. I'm making another SSY-1 setup now. But my main laser is more advanced, but still cheap.

Special hello to Colin, who got me excited about holography experiments, and all your feedback.

Sincerely,

Bill Jensen

Now in Redmond, Washington.
